metadata.question: Was the rainfall in Seattle between September through November in 2021 larger than that in 2020 and in 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Seattle, WA (approximately -122.3321, 47.6062) - Time periods: Sept-Nov for 2019, 2020, and 2021 - Collection: CHIRPS daily precipitation data (good global coverage) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for CHIRPS (it's already a precipitation product) - Just sum up the precipitation values 3. Logic: - Calculate total rainfall for each year period - Compare 2021 > 2020 AND 2021 > 2019 - Check for C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (null/invalid results) - Valid answer: A if both conditions true, B otherwise ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry and time periods const seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062]); const buffer = seattle.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Seattle // 2. Get CHIRPS precipitation data for each year const rainfall2019 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate('2019-09-01', '2019-12-01') .filterBounds(seattle); const rainfall2020 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate('2020-09-01', '2020-12-01') .filterBounds(seattle); const rainfall2021 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate('2021-09-01', '2021-12-01') .filterBounds(seattle); // Check collection sizes const size2019 = await rainfall2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = await rainfall2020.size().getInfo(); const size2021 = await rainfall2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log(`2020 Images: ${size2020}`); console.log(`2021 Images: ${size2021}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0 || size2021 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Sum precipitation for each period const sum2019 = rainfall2019.select('precipitation').sum(); const sum2020 = rainfall2020.select('precipitation').sum(); const sum2021 = rainfall2021.select('precipitation').sum(); // 4. Calculate total rainfall with pixel count validation const stats2019 = await sum2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: buffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2020 = await sum2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: buffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2021 = await sum2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: buffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const total2019 = stats2019.precipitation_mean; const total2020 = stats2020.precipitation_mean; const total2021 = stats2021.precipitation_mean; const count2019 = stats2019.precipitation_count; const count2020 = stats2020.precipitation_count; const count2021 = stats2021.precipitation_count; console.log(`2019: ${total2019?.toFixed(2)} mm (Pixels: ${count2019})`); console.log(`2020: ${total2020?.toFixed(2)} mm (Pixels: ${count2020})`); console.log(`2021: ${total2021?.toFixed(2)} mm (Pixels: ${count2021})`); // 5. Validation and final answer if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0 || count2021 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (total2019 == null || total2020 == null || total2021 == null || isNaN(total2019) || isNaN(total2020) || isNaN(total2021)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if 2021 rainfall is larger than both 2020 AND 2019 if (total2021 > total2020 && total2021 > total2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
